description: One row per instrument in the screening universe: S&P 500 companies and curated ETFs. Static reference data only - no prices, correlations or statistics live here.

columns.name: symbol
columns.description: Cboe ticker, the spelling every price tool takes. E.g. 'NVDA', 'BRK.B'.

columns.name: sec_symbol
columns.description: SEC ticker spelling, which uses '-' for share classes. E.g. 'BRK-B'.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Company or fund name from the listing directory. Rarely NULL when that directory omits a fund; the symbol still trades.

columns.name: is_etf
columns.description: True for an exchange-traded fund, false for an operating company.

columns.name: in_sp500
columns.description: True if the name is an S&P 500 constituent.

columns.name: cik
columns.description: SEC Central Index Key. NULL for most ETFs, which are not SEC filers.

columns.name: gics_sector
columns.description: GICS sector, the standard equity classification. Prefer this for resolving a sector to its symbols.

columns.name: gics_sub_industry
columns.description: GICS sub-industry, a much finer grouping. Best for finding close substitutes to pair.

columns.name: etf_family
columns.description: Which curated ETF family the fund belongs to. NULL for stocks.

columns.name: leverage
columns.description: Stated daily multiple of the underlying: 3.0 for TQQQ, -1.0 for SH, 1.0 for a plain fund.

columns.name: underlying
columns.description: The fund this one tracks a multiple of, when there is one. E.g. TQQQ -> QQQ.
